A powerful fusion of Yoga & Pilates led by Dr. Noelle Reid. Build strength, improve flexibility, release stress and elevate your mind.

About this Event

Sunlit Yoga & Pilates @ BIG CHIEFJoin us for an energizing in-person session of Yoga & Pilates at the vibrant BIG CHIEF space! Whether you're looking to stretch, strengthen, or just vibe with good people, this event is perfect for all levels. Bring your mat, soak up some sun, and let's flow together for a great time and even better energy. Can't wait to see you there!
Expect to enjoy a 50minute Yogalates Flow, ending with a restorative Soundbath. Participants will receive a Big Chief goodie bag ($20 value) full of quality products to indulge on site or take home. Must be 18yo or older to participate.

Also check out other in Los Angeles, Health & Wellness events in Los Angeles.
